scenes.text: I don’t even know how to explain this, but it felt like I walked into a museum of myself.
scenes.query: bright surreal museum hall person walking window light cinematic

scenes.text: Like, not a normal museum.
scenes.query: surreal museum interior impossible architecture soft bright light

scenes.text: There was no ceiling.
scenes.query: vast atrium open ceiling sunlight surreal architecture

scenes.text: The floor looked like black glass.
scenes.query: reflective black glass floor bright gallery cinematic

scenes.text: The walls went on forever, and every room had my name on it.
scenes.query: endless hallway museum doors warm light surreal

scenes.text: At first, I thought, “Okay… maybe I’m dead.”
scenes.query: person standing alone vast white gallery dramatic light

scenes.text: But then this voice beside me said, “No. You’re just finally looking.”
scenes.query: faceless guide silhouette beside person glowing museum light

scenes.text: And when I turned, there was this guide standing there.
scenes.query: faceless guide figure standing in bright foggy hallway

scenes.text: No face. No body really. Just a presence.
scenes.query: abstract human presence glowing silhouette soft light

scenes.text: Like something that knew me better than I knew myself.
scenes.query: person facing glowing silhouette mirror light cinematic

scenes.text: The first room was me as a kid.
scenes.query: child sitting quiet sunlit room cinematic memory

scenes.text: I saw myself sitting there, quiet, watching everything.
scenes.query: quiet child sitting by window watching warm light

scenes.text: Watching grown people be hurt, watching pain move through a room like smoke, watching everybody act like nothing happened.
scenes.query: smoke drifting through sunlit room emotional cinematic

scenes.text: And I wanted to look away.
scenes.query: person turning away from bright room emotional close up

scenes.text: But the guide said, “That one learned how to survive by reading the room.”
scenes.query: silhouette guide pointing toward room golden light

scenes.text: Then the next room was the angry me.
scenes.query: man shadow tense in warm lit room cinematic

scenes.text: The defensive me.
scenes.query: person defensive posture sunlight through blinds cinematic

scenes.text: The version of me that could turn cold fast.
scenes.query: cold blue room person silhouette window light

scenes.text: The one that would rather push somebody away before they got close enough to touch the wound.
scenes.query: person pushing away outstretched hand bright moody light

scenes.text: And I said, “I don’t like that version of me.”
scenes.query: person confronting reflection mirror warm gallery light

scenes.text: The guide said, “You don’t have to like him. But you do need to understand what he was protecting.”
scenes.query: guide and person looking at armor display museum light

scenes.text: That hit me.
scenes.query: person close up realization golden window light

scenes.text: Because then I started seeing all of them.
scenes.query: multiple silhouettes in bright museum hallway surreal

scenes.text: The jealous me.
scenes.query: person watching from doorway green light cinematic

scenes.text: The lonely me.
scenes.query: lonely person sitting in large sunlit empty room

scenes.text: The one who smiled when I was breaking.
scenes.query: person smiling sadly mirror cracked light cinematic

scenes.text: The one who said, “I’m good,” when I was nowhere close to good.
scenes.query: person pretending smile window light emotional

scenes.text: The one who acted like he didn’t care, because caring had cost too much before.
scenes.query: person alone city window warm light emotional

scenes.text: And every room I walked into, I realized something.
scenes.query: person walking through connected museum rooms bright light

scenes.text: None of those versions were enemies.
scenes.query: many silhouettes standing peacefully in bright gallery

scenes.text: They were old armor.
scenes.query: old armor museum exhibit warm spotlight cinematic

scenes.text: Old uniforms.
scenes.query: old uniforms hanging in museum warm light

scenes.text: Old masks I put on when life felt too heavy to carry with my bare hands.
scenes.query: masks on wall museum person hands warm light

scenes.text: Then I reached the last room.
scenes.query: last room doorway glowing bright museum cinematic

scenes.text: No statue.

scenes.text: No picture.

scenes.text: Just a mirror.

scenes.text: The child.

scenes.text: The fighter.
scenes.query: determined person silhouette warm dramatic light

scenes.text: The dreamer.

scenes.text: The hurt one.

scenes.text: The one who gave up.

scenes.text: The one who kept going anyway.

scenes.text: And for the first time, I didn’t try to erase any of them.

scenes.text: Maybe healing isn’t becoming someone new.

scenes.text: Maybe healing is walking back through every room inside yourself…
